title: Beyond Toxic: Toxicity Detection Datasets are Not Enough for Brand Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Cross-dataset evaluation by training binary text classification models on specific standard toxicity datasets (AHS, KTC, JUB) and testing their performance (F1-scores) on an out-of-domain private brand safety dataset to measure domain mismatch and generalization gaps.
Comparing model performance using different weighted sampling strategies (equal probability sampling across classes and datasets) to analyze the impact of class imbalance on classification metrics.
